scope: Read-only, module-only. No HTTP endpoint. No Pilot or Production contact.

artifacts.purpose: Loads the eight modules PropertyRecord.assemble() needs under Node, behind a controlled and allow-listed window shim.
102 assertions across the eleven required properties. Offline: every transport is a local function.

reads.tenants_table: fallback only — read when the property blob carries no tenants

deliberately_absent.tenant_review_audit: feeds activityLog, which PropertyRecord never reads
deliberately_absent.cam_reconciliations: the record's cam section reads the camReconciliation snapshot from the blob; the browser's extra merge runs through loadCamResults(id, getCamYear()), and getCamYear() is localStorage session state

authorization.redundant_filter: the property read carries user_id=eq.<uid> as well as the independent ownership probe
authorization.service_role: transport credential only; never consulted in a decision
authorization.probe_failure_is_refusal: a non-2xx ownership probe returns not_authorized, not ownership

window_shim.why_needed: property-workspace.js reads window.Selectors (line 42) and window.PropertyReference (line 86) at CALL time, so assemble() throws ReferenceError without a window

excluded_and_why.Selectors: selectors.js references a bare ReviewEngine global; including it would require leaking a second global. collectAttention degrades by design without it.

containment.blocked_writes_note: cam-pool.js requires money-cents.js from inside a function; its UMD tail then assigns itself to whatever window it finds. The seal refuses it and cam-pool takes the require's return value instead.

degradation_reporting.meta_unavailable_semantics: unchanged — it still means 'could not be composed'
degradation_reporting.attention_handling: attention IS composed, from fewer inputs, so it is NOT listed in meta.unavailable; the difference is reported as degraded['attention.without_selectors_readiness']

server_origin_metadata.additive: every meta key the browser record carries survives

defect_found_and_fixed_during_the_phase.what: _evidenceRowToSnapshot initially emitted sourcePage instead of page, and an extra extractedAt field
defect_found_and_fixed_during_the_phase.consequence: silent — no throw; every page citation would have been dropped and `when` would have carried a value the browser does not have
defect_found_and_fixed_during_the_phase.how_caught: an assertion comparing the server mapping's keys against script.js's, key for key
defect_found_and_fixed_during_the_phase.status: corrected; the mapping is now field-for-field identical to script.js

survivor.name: D-prune-removed
survivor.mutation: delete the _pruneToAllowList(_shim) call site in load()
survivor.assessment: EQUIVALENT for the current dependency set, and reported as such rather than fake-killed. The prune is the load-time half of the guarantee the Proxy seal gives at call time. No module in today's eight attaches an extra name during load, so removing the call changes nothing observable. The function itself is covered — D-prune-inverted and D-prune-silent both die — and the post-load shim contents are asserted directly (I4). It is kept as defence for a future dependency that does attach one.

gaps_the_first_mutation_run_exposed: an ownership probe returning a non-2xx was untested (H-ownership-ignores-status survived) — now A9.401/403/500/503
a failed property read was untested (H-property-read-failure-ignored survived) — now A10/A11/A12
the read-only guard's method list was asserted against itself (H-write-method-dropped survived) — now D0 pins it to a literal

failing_assertions: 4 control(s) promise an object and navigate generically
review actions do not carry the tenant id
